source: PaperAid Final Implementation Rulebook v1.0 (28 September 2026), §13 and Appendices C3, G, H; CW-047 amended by owner decision 2026-09-30
amendments: CW-047: an explicit prohibition of generative AI no longer disables drafting; the draft carries the last-page note "This document was drafted by an AI-assisted third party.", which the student cannot remove from PaperAid's output (owner decision 2026-09-30).

define.expectation: Give precise meaning; distinguish from related concepts where useful.

identify.expectation: Select and name the relevant items.

describe.expectation: Present the relevant characteristics, stages or sequence.

summarise.expectation: Condense the key ideas without unnecessary detail.

explain.expectation: Show how or why: make the causal, mechanistic or logical connection.

analyse.expectation: Break the subject into components and examine their relationships.

critically_analyse.expectation: Analyse and evaluate evidence, assumptions, strengths, weaknesses and limitations.

evaluate.expectation: Judge using explicit or inferable criteria and evidence.

critically_evaluate.expectation: Judge rigorously against criteria, weighing competing evidence and limitations.

discuss.expectation: Develop a balanced, reasoned examination; take the precise expectation from the rubric or context.

assess.expectation: Determine significance, value, extent or effectiveness from evidence.

critically_assess.expectation: Determine value or effectiveness rigorously, weighing competing evidence.

examine.expectation: Investigate closely and explain significant features and relationships.

explore.expectation: Investigate several dimensions without forcing one conclusion.

to_what_extent.expectation: Evaluate degree and state a qualified acceptance or rejection.

justify.expectation: Give evidence-based reasons for a choice or position.

critique.expectation: Evaluate strengths, weaknesses, assumptions, evidence and implications.

review.expectation: Summarise and evaluate a body of information in context.

interpret.expectation: Explain the meaning and significance of evidence, data or findings.

illustrate.expectation: Explain using relevant examples and evidence.

recommend.expectation: Present feasible action justified by analysis.

apply.expectation: Use a theory, model or method in the given case or context.

design.expectation: Construct a coherent solution, model or plan under the constraints.

reflect.expectation: Analyse experience and learning rather than merely narrate it.
